== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タスケンの略奪</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して運命数を引く。運命数＜（場にいるタスケン・レイダーの人数）であれば、相手のユーズドデッキをあさる（カードを探す）こと。そこにあったすべてのビークル、武器、アイテムはロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「サンド・ピープルは人数を隠すため、バンサに乗る時は一列に進む。」しばしば、よそものを襲って装備を奪い、ルークのランドスピーダーも略奪にあった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tusken Scavengers]].

'''Lore''' — “Sand People ride banthas in single file to hide their numbers.” They often attack outsiders and take equipment. Luke’s landspeeder was raided as well.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force and draw destiny. If destiny is less than the number of Tusken Raiders on table, scavenge the opponent’s Used Pile. All vehicles, weapons, and items found there are lost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Game text names アイテム rather than devices. Lore says Luke’s landspeeder 略奪にあった. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-tuskenscavengers.gif|Original English face]], [[Tusken Scavengers]].</ref>
